summary: Signal Stage is a multiplayer walkable motion-graphics stage with a synchronized, seeded 198-second cinematic on the measured 160-bpm track. A director supplies one shared shader clock and roll state to the field, eye, serpents, tunnel, chamber, sun-eye and full-screen look; measured-energy vision slots also steer a shared camera cut sequence.
places: places/main/config.yaml (main, 3D) - black void stage, spawn/gravity and place-wide scripts/look-trip.js atmosphere look.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - director and stage floor; field, eye and now-built serpents assemblies around the origin and at the eye portal.
places/main/cells/x0z-1.scene - sun-eye layers and five tunnel layers along -Z.
places/main/cells/x0z-3.scene - chamber layers and tunnel-knot at the chamber transition.
places/main/cells/x0y2z0.scene, x0y3z0.scene, x0y4z0.scene - blueprint box placeholders for sun-father, moon-mother, contour-oracle and many-armed vision sites high above the stage.
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer services, player/camera templates, movement and cine actions, arrival, lighting, HUD and nametag.
templates/player.js#player composes scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js and scripts/player.js; templates/camera.js#camera runs scripts/camera.js.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#director - scripts/stage.js all-audience synchronized track and trip-parameter director.
scripts/ui.js - viewer-local ROLL/CUT controls and cinematic status HUD.
places/main/config.yaml atmosphere.look - installs scripts/look-trip.js as the full-screen trip post-processing look.
shared: scripts/lib/cine.js - CPU score clock, section lookup, seeded camera interpolation and vision camera cuts; used by player/camera/HUD and stage.
scripts/lib/data/score.yml and shots.yml - section/layer/lens score and authored camera keys; scripts/lib/data/energy.yml stores measured beat, bar and vision-slot energy.
scripts/lib/visions.js - ten-being deck, seeded slot dealing, vision camera shot and measured energy lookup; consumed by cine.js and stage.js.
scripts/lib/trip.js - shared shader clock, kick runs, seeded palette/random helpers, scored layer/mask visibility, lens bending and vision visibility/clocks.
scripts/field-lib.js, eye-lib.js, tunnel-lib.js, chamber-lib.js and chamber-fx.js - family-specific spatial, geometry and shader helpers.
scripts/sun-lib.js - sun-eye timing/color/ripple helpers; scripts/serpents-data.js and serpents-curve.js - shared serpent body records, spine and frame math.
notableExports: scripts/player.js exports onInput, update; scripts/camera.js exports finiteNumber, update; scripts/stage.js exports update; scripts/lib/cine.js exports SCORE, SHOTS, CINE, cineTime, sectionAt, rollRnd, cameraAt, beatEnv.

scripts/lib/visions.js exports BEINGS, dealVisions, visionAt, visionShot, energyAt; scripts/lib/trip.js exports KICK_RUNS, tripClock, win, pal, shown, lens, bendUv, visionShown, visionU and mask helpers; scripts/look-trip.js exports look.
scripts/field-disc.js, field-glyphs.js, field-orbs.js and field-stalks.js export geometry; their paired field-* materials export material; field-mandala.js exports material.
scripts/eye-*-geo.js export geometry/collider where defined; eye-iris.js, eye-beads.js, eye-knot.js, eye-lids.js, eye-pupil.js and eye-rays.js export material.
scripts/serpents-*-geo.js export geometry (and collider where defined); serpent layer materials export material; serpents-lib.js exports shared skin, clock, movement, lighting and cut helpers.
scripts/tunnel-geo.js exports geometry, collider; tunnel-lib.js exports spatial/color helpers; tunnel layer scripts export material.

scripts/chamber-*-geo.js export geometry/collider where defined and chamber-*-mat.js export material; chamber-fx.js supplies shader helpers; scripts/sun-lib.js exports shared sun helpers and sun layers export material.
ownership: scripts/player.js - local movement intent/velocity and shared world.state.cine = {start, by, seed} or null on cine input.
scripts/stage.js on #director - shared music session and propagation of t0/on/seed/k0/k1 to trip-tagged materials plus per-being vw0/vw1 vision slots.
scripts/camera.js / templates/camera.js - viewer-local camera pose/FOV and seeded shot path, including the currently dealt vision cut.
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - avatar gait/sit state; scripts/ui.js and ui/nametag.js - viewer-local presentation only.
places/main/config.yaml owns atmosphere, spawn, gravity, terrain mode and look params; world.config.yaml owns world services, inputs and templates.
flows: P/cine action or HUD sendAction('cine') → scripts/player.js onInput → world.state.cine={start: now+300ms, by, seed} or null.
world.state.cine → scripts/ui.js render → viewer-local ROLL/CUT and rolling progress/section label.
world.state.cine + score track → #director scripts/stage.js → shared audio at c.start; director stops audio and clears ended cine.
scripts/stage.js → trip-tagged materials and look params t0/on/seed/k0/k1; materials consume synchronized clock, roll seed and current/next measured kick run.
energy.yml → trip.js KICK_RUNS and visions.js ENERGY.visions → stage supplies kick bounds and seeded vision slot bounds to tagged scene objects.
cine.js cameraAt → visions.js visionAt/visionShot when in a dealt slot, otherwise seeded shots.yml path → scripts/camera.js viewer camera.
score.yml + trip.js tripClock/shown/lens/mask helpers → field, eye, serpents, tunnel, chamber and look-trip shader cutouts, clocks and UV effects.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene serpents layer objects → serpents geometry/material family; serpents-lib.js and serpents-curve.js share body movement, skin and closed-form curve/frame math.
scripts/sun-lib.js → sun-eye disc/drips/halo shaders; scripts/tunnel-geo.js kind-selected geometry → tunnel wall/core/dust/gates/ribs and knot layers.

places/main/config.yaml atmosphere.look params → scripts/look-trip.js full-screen score look; world.config.yaml movement actions → scripts/player.js velocity, with templates/player.js also running avatar locomotion.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/field-* - mandala, stalks, orbs and glyph/cartouche field layers share field-lib.js placement/timing while geometry and materials vary motifs.
scripts/eye-* - iris, pupil, rays, lids, beads and added knot-flower make the portal; eye-lib.js shares eye math and iris geometry is reused for pupil with different parameters.

scripts/serpents-* - eight co-located layers build striped/scaled bodies, arches, beads, cones, knots, rose beads and totem; serpents-lib.js and serpents-curve.js share appearance and spine/frame calculations.
scripts/tunnel-* - wall, core, dust, gates, ribs and knot share tunnel geometry kinds and tunnel-lib.js spatial/color helpers; materials vary motif and seeded palette.
scripts/chamber-* - room, circuit, hands, hex, Lissajous, solids and bilateral mask share chamber shader helpers and scored cutouts.
scripts/sun-disc.js, sun-drips.js and sun-halo.js - co-located sun-eye layers share sun-lib.js but vary disc, hanging-drip and depth-halo imagery.
scripts/look-trip.js and scripts/lib/trip.js - place-wide post-processing and scene shaders share score clock, seeded selection, layer/mask visibility and lens math.
templates/player.js composes humanoid-locomotion.js with player.js on each character: gait/sit animation versus input intent and movement velocity.
probableOrphans: scripts/flat-starter-terrain.js and scripts/lib/data/world.yml - terrain generator/data without a consumer while main terrain is off.
scripts/flower.js, scripts/grass.js, scripts/grass-look.js and scripts/pebble.js - meadow decoration scripts with no current place consumer.
migrationNotes: world.state.cine is the synchronized start/cut source; starts are scheduled 300 ms ahead. cine.js uses milliseconds for start/ctx.now() and seconds for score/shot keys.

stage.js converts c.start to shader t0 seconds modulo 3600 and repeats param pushes over several ticks so late-built materials receive the same roll; tagged trip materials need t0/on/seed and kick bounds k0/k1.
energy.yml is the measured-track source for kick runs and vision slots; visions are seeded into slots, and stage sets vw0/vw1 (-1,-1 when not dealt) on objects tagged vision-<being id>.

Vision deck IDs currently include ten beings; four scene cells shown here contain only blueprint boxes (no vision-<id> trip visuals yet), so camera/deal support should not be mistaken for finished visual assemblies.

Score is 198 seconds at 160 bpm, first beat 0.35 s; shader tripClock follows the roll when on and otherwise free-runs the silent duration loop. Units are metres, +Y up; main composition runs from field origin through tunnel to chamber on -Z.

Layer visibility is shader cutout via shown()/masks, not a fade to black; a hidden layer must uncover what is behind it. Serpent and eye knot are active placed assemblies, not the former serpent placeholder.
